title: Cross-team handshake inventory and lightweight tracker - Jan 2026
content:
Purpose: quick inventory of cross-team handoffs, one-off asks, and small decisions that need owner/time estimates. Lightweight—use this to escalates blockers and to make sure small dependencies don't fall through cracks.

Summary notes:
- Snapshot date: 2026-01-12 (last scrub 2026-01-14).
- Quick counts: 12 items total, 3 blocked, 4 awaiting sign-off, 5 on-boarding/ops work.
- Primary escalation channel: #ops-handshakes and weekly 15-min sync Fridays at 09:30 PST.

Table (columns): ID | Topic / short description | Initiator | Responsible | Stakeholders | Due | Status | Blockers / notes | Quick next step | Slack thread / ticket

1 | Dedicated region config for ACME pilot — confirm routing to eu-west | Maya Chen | Platform Infra (Liam) | Sales (Priya), SE team | 2026-01-20 | in_progress | Need region IP whitelist from customer; infra waiting on network team | Ask customer for prod CIDR by 2026-01-15, set tentative mapping | #acme-pilot / JIRA-3247

2 | Billing metric mismatch: embeddings units vs usage dashboard | Finance ops | Finance (Sofia) | Billing eng, Product analytics | 2026-01-18 | in_review | Metric definition unclear (tokenization differences) | Confirm tokenization standard; sync with analytics 01/16 | CONFLUENCE-1583 / billing-check-jan

3 | Canary policy for new base model (v2) on Hosted API | Serving runtime | Eng - Serving Runtime (Ravi) | Product-hosted-api, SRE | 2026-01-22 | awaiting_signoff | Need SLA language + rollback criteria | Draft rollout playbook by 01/17, review with Product 01/18 | github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842

4 | Quick eval: quantized 4-bit perf on p4d for long-sequence chat | Applied ML | ML (Priya K.) | Infra, Cost team | 2026-01-25 | blocked | Access to dedicated p4d pool delayed | Get temporary GPU slot; run 3 sample prompts | #ml-quantization

5 | Onboarding checklist for new SE hire (region-specific templates) | Solutions Eng | SE (Carlos) | DevEx, Docs | 2026-01-19 | done | N/A | Publish template to drive | #se-onboarding

6 | Small customer request: private deployment logs retention options | Customer Success | CS (Dana) | Security, Product | 2026-01-21 | in_progress | Compliance team asked for audit sample | Produce sample retention policy + config options | CS to send customer sample by 01/18 | JIRA-3310

7 | Temporary routing rule for overflow capacity during Blackbox test | Platform Eng | Platform (Nora) | Serving Runtime, SRE | 2026-01-15 | blocked | Traffic spike untested; SRE needs test window | Schedule short blast test 01/16 02:00-02:10 UTC | #blackbox-tests

8 | Short analysis: top 5 prompt sets causing quality regressions (Feb rollout) | Product Ops | Product (Ibrahim) | ML, QA | 2026-02-02 | awaiting_signoff | Need final eval metrics from QA | Merge prompt list + evals; sign-off meeting 01/20 | CONFLUENCE-1699

9 | Tiny doc: internal guide for 'fallback model' semantics | DevEx | DevEx (Sofia R.) | Serving Runtime, Product | 2026-01-17 | in_review | language ambiguity on semantic fallback order | Decide on 3-tier fallback policy; update SDK docs | PR to docs repo by 01/16 | docs-pr-455

10 | Manual quota override for trial orgs (one-off) | Growth | Growth (Alex) | Billing, Infra | 2026-01-14 | done | Logged exception for 5 orgs | Add rule to exceptions tracker | #growth-ops

11 | Light-risk: Keepalive / connection timeout tweak for older SDK versions | SDK | Eng - DevEx (Maya) | Support, SRE | 2026-01-28 | in_progress | Need compatibility test matrix | Run regression tests against v1.2 and v1.3 | #sdk-compat

12 | Spot-check: per-token latency outliers in eu-central region | Observability | Obs (Harper) | Infra, Serving Runtime | 2026-01-23 | blocked | Correlating root cause across logs is noisy | Collect localized traces, increase sample windows | Trace capture 01/15-01/16 | #obs-latency

Notes to self / casual fragments:
- If an item is "blocked" for >4 business days escalate to cross-functional slack thread and owner manager.
- Use "status" as quick shorthand; leave details in notes.
- Several rows are intentionally light — this doc is for quick eyeballing at ops huddles.
- Questions: should small customer asks (like #6) live in CS docs instead? for now keep a copy here for visibility.

Action log (most recent small actions):
- 2026-01-14: Maya pinged customer for ACME CIDR; added note to row 1.
- 2026-01-14: Billing ops ran quick tokenization sample; results in linked CONFLUENCE page.
- 2026-01-13: SE onboarding template published (row 5 -> done).

How to use: update your row, add minimal note when moving status, and tag the slack thread. Weekly scrub on Fridays (15 min). If you add a linked ticket put the short id in the ticket column.

End of tracker.
